list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Version: 0.2-alpha feat: enterprise expansion, metrics, and ORM layer
Implemented centralized config.yml loading via SnakeYAML for shared cross-plugin remote connections Added native Java reflection ORM (@Table, @Column, @Id) bridging directly into fluent query builders Built /sundb status command for both Paper and Velocity exposing native HikariCP/Lettuce pool statistics Added MultiPlayerStore write-through cache decorator syncing Redis memory instantly to MySQL Fixed cross-dialect ON CONFLICT constraints for PostgreSQL and SQLite upserts in InsertBuilder Bootstrapped JUnit 5 and Testcontainers framework for dockerized SQL integration testing Overhauled documentation with an 8-chapter EXAMPLE_PLUGIN.md cookbook and full API wiki.
Tested-by: sun-mc-dev <sun.minecraftdev@gmail.com>
